svg.aria-label: The same requirement satisfied by two defensible designs. One service keeps everything in a single process: it buys simplicity and bills shared fate. A split isolates failure and deploys, and bills network calls, coordination and partial states. Neither is correct; being unable to name the bill is.
svg.text: ONE REQUIREMENT · TWO DEFENSIBLE SHAPES · TWO DIFFERENT BILLS

svg.text: Neither of these is wrong. Choosing one and being unable to say what it cost is.
